context: Kenji and Ren go to the gym together; gentle workout chat.
purpose: Mentor and protégé bonding through exercise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Casual, warm Kansai inflection. Genuine interest, not perfunctory. Light lean-in, friendly shoulder-check energy. No pressure, just checking in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 汗、いっぱいかいてます。
lines.style: Breathless but genuinely pleased. A little self-deprecating laugh behind it. Slight embarrassment about the effort showing, but happy to be noticed. Quick, honest exhale.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Stamina builds with it—keep at it and you'll feel the difference.
lines.style: Steady, encouraging mentor tone. Kansai warmth underneath. Matter-of-fact wisdom, not lecturing. The kind of thing said once, meant for years. Easy confidence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 健司さんも、続けてますね。
lines.en: You've been keeping it up too, though.
lines.style: Soft admission with genuine respect underneath. A little careful—not flattering, just observing. Quiet admiration from someone who notices consistency in others.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おう、お互い、頑張ろうや。
lines.style: Open, brotherly. Kansai ease at the end. Not a command, an invitation. Warm hand on the shoulder in voice form. Simple solidarity.
